title: Is the Policy Gradient a Gradient?
abstract: arXiv:1906.07073v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The policy gradient theorem describes the gradient of the expected discounted return with respect to an agent's policy parameters. However, many policy gradient methods omit the outer discount factor, yielding an update that need not equal the gradient of the discounted objective. Is the resulting update the gradient of another objective? This has been an open question for several years, and this lack of theoretical clarity has led to an abundance of misstatements in the literature. We answer this question for the resulting episode-summed, on-policy update by proving that it need not equal the gradient of any function. Further, we construct a counterexample in which exact expected updates drive the policy toward a deterministic limit that is globally pessimal with respect to both the discounted and undiscounted objectives, while the parameter diverges. translated_title: 策略梯度真的是梯度吗？
translated_abstract: 策略梯度定理描述了期望折扣回报关于智能体策略参数的梯度。然而，许多策略梯度方法省略了外层折扣因子，由此产生的更新不必等于折扣目标的梯度。那么这个更新是否是另一个目标的梯度呢？这多年来一直是一个悬而未决的问题，这种理论上的不清晰也导致文献中出现了大量错误的表述。本文针对由此产生的按回合求和的在策略更新回答了这一问题，通过证明证明该更新不必等于任何函数的梯度。此外，作者还构建了一个反例：在该反例中，精确的期望更新会将策略推向一个确定性的极限，该极限无论对于折扣目标还是未折扣目标而言都是全局最差的，同时参数会发散。作者通过调研文献来引出这项工作，并表明文献中仍然存在（大量相关误用）。
tldr: 本文证明了省略折扣因子的策略梯度更新不必是任何函数的梯度，并构造反例表明该更新会使策略收敛到在折扣与未折扣目标下均全局最差的确定性极限。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the policy gradient update omitting the discount factor need not be the gradient of any function, and constructs a counterexample where such updates drive the policy toward a deterministic limit that is globally pessimal under both discounted and undiscounted objectives.
